# The job and the foundations

::: {.partintro}
The first modules give you the ground the rest of the book stands on: the Python habits that keep model calls safe and fast, what an AI engineer builds around a model, and the parts of probability, machine learning and language processing you will actually use at work.

None of it is research-level. If an idea is here, a later module or a real job needs it.
